segments.t: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people,
segments.note: 「After he had finished speaking」は Ἐπειδὴ ἐπλήρωσεν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα αὐτοῦ

segments.t: he entered into Capernaum.
A certain centurion’s servant,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： Ἑκατοντάρχου τινος δοῦλος。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ὃς ἦν αὐτῷ ἔντιμος, κακῶς ἔχων ἤμελλεν τελευτᾶν。「sick」は κακῶς ἔχων

segments.t: When he heard about Jesus,
segments.note: 「When」は ἀκούσας。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.
When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying,
segments.note: 「When」は παραγενόμενοι。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “He is worthy for you to do this for him,
segments.note: ὅτι は引用の導入

segments.t: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ἀγαπᾷ γὰρ τὸ ἔθνος ἡμῶν καὶ τὴν συναγωγὴν αὐτὸς ᾠκοδόμησεν ἡμῖν

segments.t: Jesus went with them.
segments.note: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἐπορεύετο σὺν αὐτοῖς

segments.t: When he was now not far from the house,
segments.note: 「When」は ἀπέχοντος の状況表現

segments.t: the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him,
segments.note: 「to him」は文脈の補い

segments.t: “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.
Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you;
segments.note: 「Therefore」は διὸ。「even」は οὐδὲ

segments.t: but say the word, and my servant will be healed.
segments.note: 「say the word」は εἰπὲ λόγῳ

segments.t: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers.
segments.note: 「For」は καὶ γὰρ

segments.t: I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes;
and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”
When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him,
segments.note: 「When」は ἀκούσας。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and turned and said to the multitude who followed him,
segments.note: 「turned and said」は στραφεὶς … εἶπεν

segments.t: “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”
segments.note: 「no, not」は οὐδὲ の強調的意訳

segments.t: Those who were sent, returning to the house,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: found that the servant who had been sick was well.
segments.note: 「who had been sick」は文脈の補足を含む τὸν δοῦλον ὑγιαίνοντα

segments.t: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain.
segments.note: 「Soon afterwards」は ἐν τῷ ἑξῆς。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： συνεπορεύοντο αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ὄχλος πολύς

segments.t: Now when he came near to the gate of the city,
segments.note: 「Now」は δὲ

segments.t: behold, one who was dead was carried out,
segments.note: 「behold, one who was dead was carried out」は καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐξεκομίζετο τεθνηκὼς

segments.t: the only born son of his mother,
and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.
When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「had compassion」は ἐσπλαγχνίσθη

segments.t: and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still.
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「stood still」は ἔστησαν

segments.t: He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”
He who was dead sat up and began to speak.
segments.note: 「He who was dead」は ὁ νεκρὸς

segments.t: Then he gave him to his mother.
segments.note: 「Then」は καὶ

segments.t: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἔλαβεν δὲ φόβος πάντας καὶ ἐδόξαζον τὸν θεὸν λέγοντες。ὅτι（10番）は引用の導入で次に同乗

segments.t: saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!”
and, “God has visited his people!”
segments.note: 「and,」は καὶ ὅτι（17番）の接続

segments.t: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λόγος οὗτος ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάσῃ τῇ περιχώρῳ

segments.t: The disciples of John told him about all these things.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἀπήγγειλαν Ἰωάννῃ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ περὶ πάντων τούτων。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない。後半（トークン10–18）は節境界のずれで19節側に現れるため未対応

segments.t: John, calling to himself two of his disciples,
segments.note: 節境界のずれ：この句はギリシャ語本文では18節後半（καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος δύο τινὰς τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἰωάννης）。当該トークンは18節側で未対応のまま残る

segments.t: sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”
segments.note: 「Jesus」は τὸν κύριον の明示。「them」は英語の補い

segments.t: When the men had come to him, they said,
segments.note: 「When」は παραγενόμενοι。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying,
‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”
segments.note: 「he who comes」は ὁ ἐρχόμενος

segments.t: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits;
segments.note: 「he」は ἐθεράπευσεν の主語（イエス）

segments.t: and to many who were blind he gave sight.
segments.note: 「who were」は英語の補い

segments.t: Jesus answered them,
segments.note: 「Jesus」は文脈の明示。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard:
segments.note: 「the things which」は ἃ

segments.t: that the blind receive their sight,
segments.note: 「that」は引用導入の補い。「receive their sight」は ἀναβλέπουσιν

segments.t: the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up,
segments.note: 各節は名詞＋動詞の並列

segments.t: and the poor have good news preached to them.
segments.note: 「have good news preached to them」は εὐαγγελίζονται（受動）の意訳

segments.t: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”
segments.note: 「finds no occasion for stumbling」は μὴ σκανδαλισθῇ の意訳。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John,
segments.note: 「When」は Ἀπελθόντων。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?
But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing?
Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.
segments.note: 「gorgeously dressed」は ἐν ἱματισμῷ ἐνδόξῳ。「live delicately」は τρυφῇ ὑπάρχοντες

segments.t: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ἀλλὰ τί ἐξήλθατε ἰδεῖν προφήτην ναί λέγω ὑμῖν καὶ περισσότερον προφήτου。「much」は περισσότερον

segments.t: This is he of whom it is written,
segments.note: 「it is written」は γέγραπται

segments.t: ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’
“For I tell you,
segments.note: 「For」は WEB が従う異読（γάρ）の訳

segments.t: among those who are born of women
segments.note: 「who are」は英語の補い

segments.t: there is not
segments.note: 「there is not」は οὐδείς ἐστιν

segments.t: a greater
segments.note: 「a greater」は μείζων

segments.t: prophet
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「prophet」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: than John
the Baptizer;
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「the Baptizer」を補う。ギリシャ語本文は Ἰωάννου のみ

segments.t: yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”
When all the people and the tax collectors heard this,
segments.note: 「When … heard this」は ἀκούσας。「this」は英語の補い。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.
segments.note: 「declared God to be just」は ἐδικαίωσαν τὸν θεόν

segments.t: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： οἱ δὲ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ νομικοὶ τὴν βουλὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἠθέτησαν εἰς ἑαυτούς μὴ βαπτισθέντες ὑπ᾽ αὐτοῦ

segments.t: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
segments.note: 句全体の対応： Τίνι οὖν ὁμοιώσω τοὺς ἀνθρώπους τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ τίνι εἰσὶν ὅμοιοι。「should」は英語の補い

segments.t: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying,
segments.note: 「They are like」は ὅμοιοί εἰσιν。「saying」は λέγει

segments.t: ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’
For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ἐλήλυθεν γὰρ Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς μὴ ἐσθίων ἄρτον μήτε πίνων οἶνον καὶ λέγετε Δαιμόνιον ἔχει

segments.t: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ἐλήλυθεν ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων καὶ λέγετε Ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος φάγος καὶ οἰνοπότης φίλος τελωνῶν καὶ ἁμαρτωλῶν

segments.t: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ ἐδικαιώθη ἡ σοφία ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν τέκνων αὐτῆς

segments.t: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： Ἠρώτα δέ τις αὐτὸν τῶν Φαρισαίων ἵνα φάγῃ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ。「invited」は Ἠρώτα … ἵνα φάγῃ

segments.t: He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.
segments.note: 「sat at the table」は κατεκλίθη（食卓に着いた）。「at the table」は英語の補い

segments.t: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner,
segments.note: 「Behold」は καὶ ἰδοὺ。「in the city」は ἐν τῇ πόλει

segments.t: when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house,
segments.note: 「when she knew that he was reclining」は ἐπιγνοῦσα ὅτι κατάκειται

segments.t: brought an alabaster jar of ointment.
Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「began to wet」は ἤρξατο βρέχειν

segments.t: and she wiped them with the hair of her head,
segments.note: 「them」は英語の補い

segments.t: kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself,
segments.note: 「Now when」は ἰδὼν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived
segments.note: 「would have perceived」は ἐγίνωσκεν ἂν

segments.t: who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”
segments.note: 「this is who touches him, that she is」は文脈の展開

segments.t: Jesus answered him,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Simon, I have something to tell you.”
He said, “Teacher, say on.”
segments.note: 「say on」は εἰπέ（言え）の意訳

segments.t: “A certain lender had two debtors.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： δύο χρεοφειλέται ἦσαν δανιστῇ τινι。「A certain lender had」は ἦσαν … τινι

segments.t: The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both.
segments.note: 「When」は μὴ ἐχόντων の状況表現

segments.t: Which of them therefore will love him most?”
Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.”
segments.note: 「He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most」は Ὑπολαμβάνω ὅτι ᾧ τὸ πλεῖον ἐχαρίσατο

segments.t: He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”
Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman?
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet,
segments.note: 「and」は文脈の接続

segments.t: but she has wet my feet with her tears,
and wiped them with the hair of her head.
segments.note: 「of her head」は WEB が従う異読（τῆς κεφαλῆς αὐτῆς）の反映。ギリシャ語本文は ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς のみ

segments.t: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： φίλημά μοι οὐκ ἔδωκας αὕτη δὲ ἀφ᾽ ἧς εἰσῆλθον οὐ διέλιπεν καταφιλοῦσά μου τοὺς πόδας。「the time」は ἀφ᾽ ἧς の意訳

segments.t: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： ἐλαίῳ τὴν κεφαλήν μου οὐκ ἤλειψας αὕτη δὲ μύρῳ ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας μου

segments.t: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven,
segments.note: 「Therefore」は οὗ χάριν。「which are many」は αἱ πολλαί

segments.t: for she loved much.
But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”
segments.note: 「one to whom」は ᾧ

segments.t: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”
segments.note: 「He」は εἶπεν の主語（イエス）。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves,
segments.note: 「with him」は συνανακείμενοι に含まれる。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Who is this who even forgives sins?”
He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε πορεύου εἰς εἰρήνην
